card.name: Content warning and boxed warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside a WARNING notice, especially a web post warning about graphic images, or a boxed-warning heading. It also fires on linking words in lists of warnings or inappropriate content.

modes.label: Graphic content warning
modes.description: Words in a post's warning that it contains disturbing images.
modes.example: WARNING: This post<< contains>> images of dead birds. I encourage you

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: Linking words inside warning section titles on drug labels.
modes.example: boxed CONTRAINDICATIONS<< AND>> WARNINGS and CLINICAL PHARM

modes.label: Inappropriate content lists
modes.description: Linking words in lists of explicit or inappropriate material.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like trigger, graphic, mature and content, as in a content warning.
card.plain: It notices a warning notice, such as a graphic-content warning, and expects words like trigger or graphic content next.
